subject.title: feat: persist catalog feed change history

question: Should ClawHub adopt this 30-day durable sequence and change-journal contract as the permanent backend for signed incremental catalog distribution?
rationale: The branch commits ClawHub and future consumers to durable sequence identity, tombstone, reset, retention, and pagination semantics while the governing RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve after contract proof
options.body: Accept the direction after the RFC and prerequisite land and live Convex fresh-install, upgrade, pagination, reset, and pruning behavior is demonstrated.

options.title: Keep snapshot-only distribution
options.body: Continue serving only the current snapshot until consumer requirements justify the persistent delta contract.

options.title: Revise delta semantics
options.body: Sponsor incremental distribution but require different retention, cursor, reset, or sequence behavior before implementation proceeds.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract proof
recommendation.body: Accept the direction after the RFC and prerequisite land and live Convex fresh-install, upgrade, pagination, reset, and pruning behavior is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses repository storage and OpenClaw consumer product boundaries rather than being a narrow implementation choice.
